୨୧ 5 hobbies that will make
you incredibly smart and fun

1. debating

• watch debates and study
the strongest arguments
• argue the side you disagree with

2. etymology

• look up where interesting
words come from

3. strategy games

• chess, go, or any game
that makes you think ahead

4. daily micro-learning

• five minutes of a new
subject every morning
